name: next-form
description: NextForm is a user-friendly drag-and-drop form builder powered by Next.js, TypeScript, DND Kit, and MongoDB. It lets you create customizable forms effortlessly with features like live previews, element customization, and seamless data integration. Perfect for saving time and creating professional forms without coding!

paragraphs: Build Customizable Drag-and-Drop Forms Like a Pro!

Welcome to NextForm, a powerful and intuitive form builder designed to make form creation a breeze. Built with cutting-edge technologies like Next.js, TypeScript, DND Kit, and MongoDB, NextForm empowers you to create highly customizable forms without any hassle.
NextForm is a feature-rich tool designed to simplify the process of building and managing forms. It offers a user-friendly drag-and-drop interface, allowing you to:
features: Drag and Drop: Add various form elements such as text fields, checkboxes, radio buttons, dropdowns, and more effortlessly.
Customize Elements: Adjust labels, validation rules, and styling options for each form element to fit your needs.
Store Data Seamlessly: Integrate with MongoDB to store and manage submitted form data efficiently.
Save Time and Effort: Forget tedious coding for complex forms. NextForm's visual builder streamlines the process.
Enhanced User Experience: Create clear and intuitive forms that ensure a smooth experience for your users.
